title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.27412v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in $T_c$. translated_title: 利用训练后的神经切线核学习材料空间的几何结构
translated_abstract: 经过训练用于预测材料性质的神经网络，其所学表示中蕴含的物理内容往往难以提取。我们使用在训练后参数处评估的神经切线核（NTK），来恢复一个仅从元素组成预测超导转变温度的网络所学习到的几何结构。基于训练后NTK的核岭回归能够很好地再现网络的预测性能，并显著优于使用初始核的回归方法。谱分析和多维标度分析揭示了一种由少数几个方向主导的几何结构。聚类和局部邻域分析将化合物组织成可识别的超导家族，并在转变温度 $T_c$ 相差悬殊的材料之间建立联系，这些材料具有相关的化学性质和强关联电子特性。这些结果确立了训练后的切线核作为探测所学材料表示的实用工具。
tldr: 本研究利用训练后参数处的神经切线核，成功提取并分析了预测超导转变温度的神经网络所学到的材料空间几何结构，揭示了少数主导方向，并将化合物组织成可识别的超导家族，为理解神经网络材料表示的物理内涵提供了实用探针。
en_tdlr: This study employs neural tangent kernels evaluated at trained parameters to extract the geometry of materials space learned by a network predicting superconducting transition temperatures, revealing a few dominant directions and organizing compounds into recognizable superconducting families, thus establishing trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations.
